description: Hard state for AI agents: typed, governed, durable state with deterministic queries, governed writes, and receipts.
rules: Setup is an operator step on the CLI: cruxible server start, then cruxible init in a Git repository; MCP has no setup tools
Read with cruxible_orient (the map), cruxible_query (rows of values with flags) and cruxible_get (one thing by reference); grep the floor under .cruxible/floor/current/ to find things by name

Change values with cruxible_set, cruxible_retire or cruxible_write; author definitions (Subjects, queries, Procedures, Lines, Triggers, policies) with cruxible_authoring_submit; ClaimTypes go through cruxible_claim_type_propose and cruxible_claim_type_migrate
A proposal is not accepted state and an approval is not activation; read accepted coordinates as state and candidate coordinates as provisional
Search for an existing Subject or Claim before minting an adjacent concept
Record contradiction as negative evidence rather than only a new positive inverse
Never request, transmit, or place a principal private key in a repository
